### Reddit Post (r/learnpython or r/androidapps)
```markdown
Title: [Showcase] PY//NOW - Offline Python Learning App for Android (30 Lessons, Embedded CPython 3.13)

Hey everyone!

I've been working on an Android app that lets you learn Python completely offline. Just pushed some major updates including multilingual docs and better organization.

**What it does:**
- Runs real CPython 3.13 on your phone (via Chaquopy)
- 30 gamified lessons from basics to decorators
- Auto-grading with assert statements
- Variable snapshot panel (see what's in memory after each run)
- Cyberpunk-themed UI because why not?

**Why offline?**
- Works in subway tunnels, airplanes, anywhere
- No account needed, no data collection
- Perfect for focus without distractions

**Tech stack:**
- Kotlin + Jetpack Compose
- Chaquopy 16.0 (embedded CPython 3.13)
- Material3 with custom cyberpunk theme

**Available on:**
- GitHub: https://github.com/Morningstar202604/mashang-python
- Gitee: https://gitee.com/badhope/mashang-python (China mirror)
- GitCode: https://gitcode.com/badhope/mashang-python (China mirror)

Download APK from Releases page (~43MB).

Would love feedback on the curriculum structure, UI design, or any bugs you find. Also happy to answer questions about the Chaquopy integration or Compose implementation!

Screenshots and more info in the README.
```

## 💡 Pro Tips

1. **Respond to Issues Quickly**: Even just "Thanks, looking into it" shows activity
2. **Label Issues Properly**: Use `bug`, `enhancement`, `good first issue`, `documentation`
3. **Celebrate Contributors**: Mention them in release notes
4. **Regular Updates**: Even small commits show the project is alive
5. **Engage on Social**: Reply to mentions, share user screenshots
